title: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Shadow Keep (Main)
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Shadow Keep - A Legacy Dungeon
Return to Main Gate Plaza - Site of Grace
Head back out through the southeast doorway and go inside the main building in the northern direction
Use Storehouse, First Floor - Site of Grace
Find your way to West Rampart - Site of Grace then return to the first floor of Storehouse (you will use this later after defeating the main boss of Shadow Keep)
Speak with Sir Ansbach
Obtain Secret Rite Scroll
Use Storehouse, Seventh Floor - Site of Grace
Speak with Redmane Freyja

Progress both NPC questlines by giving the scroll to Sir Ansbach, informing him about Redmane Freyja and give the Letter to Freyja to Redmane. (Use teleporter and exhaust both of their dialogues to receive the Golden Lion Shield from Freyja)
Use the switch found on the 6th floor to switch the ceiling statues
Return to the first floor and jump between the newly moved statues to reach an upper area

Use the Dark Chamber Entrance - Site of Grace NOTE: Before going inside, make sure you have progressed Needle Knight Leda and Hornsent questline. Hornsent's quest can get bricked if you trigger Messmer's cutscene by going inside his room. In our playthrough, we progressed this after entering through the Main Gate for the first time. See #15 of the Game Progress or Shadow Keep Underground (Main Gate and Recluse River).
Fight Messmer the Impaler (It's important to summon Hornsent during the fight for his questline)
Return to Hornsent Grandam in Belurat Tower Settlement (You will receive one final item from her)
Teleport to West Rampart - Site of Grace
Cross the bridge to reach the Ancient Ruins of Rauh

links.text: Shadow Keep Underground (Main Gate and Recluse River

title: MAIN PLAZA CONTINUATION
text: After arriving in the Main Gate Plaza, use the shortcut you just opened then go up the ramp, in which you'll be surrounded by four Shadow Militiamen. After arriving at the top of the ramp, you can head up the stairs. You can pick up x8 Bone Dart from a corpse by the stairs. A Fire Knight will be waiting across the bridge. As you are walking to the Fire Knight, pick up the x8 Smithing Stone [2] from the dead body. The Fire Knight uses slow wide swings when attacking, so you can attack or even stagger it after dodging one attack.

After defeating the Fire Knight, you can go through the big archway it was previously patrolling, which leads to a lift. Use the lift to go up, and you will end up in the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]].

title: STOREHOUSE, FIRST FLOOR (DETOUR)
text: On the west side of the First Floor Site of Grace, you'll find a room filled with Shadow Undead, along with a dead body sitting against the stone tablets containing x1 Rune Arc. Head inside the room, and you will find a lift which you can ride going down.

After arriving at the bottom of the lift, you will be in a room connecting two other rooms. In the room west, you will find a corpse that you can loot for x1 Gold-Pickled Fowl Foot along with a Living Jar hiding by the entrance of the room. The second room is a hallway, which also connects two more rooms. The room on the left will have a Living Jar by the door along with a corpse sitting by the railing containing the Ash of War: Wall of Sparks.

In the northern room, you'll find a Living Jar running up the stairs. Defeat the Living Jar, but don't go down the stairs yet. Go to the hallway beside the stairs, then hit the Illusory wall to reveal a hidden room. You can obtain x1 Battlefield Priest's Cookbook (4). After obtaining the cookbook, you can now head down the stairs.

You will find yourself in a room filled with Living Jars. After dealing with the Living Jars, go west to find a corpse containing x5 Hefty Beast Bone behind a jar. Head south to get into another room filled with more Living Jars. On the eastern side, you'll find a Living Jar standing in front of an item. Defeat the Living Jar and two more small Living Jars, then loot the item to receive the Iris of Grace - an item you can hand over to an NPC later. You'll also find a dead corpse lying on a bed southwest of the Iris of Grace which contains x1 Hefty Cracked Pot.

After clearing the room, head west to enter a room. Be cautious as you are entering the room, as a Living Jar will attack you on the right side. Head down either staircase, as they both lead to the same area. This room leads outside to the West Rampart Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]], which is another entrance to the Shadow Keep. Travel back to the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace to resume exploring the Shadow Keep.

links.text: Ash of War: Wall of Sparks

markers.text: Ash of War: Wall of Sparks

title: EXPLORING THE SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, FIRST FLOOR
text: As soon as you arrive on the first floor, head east to find a dead corpse containing x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver. Afterwards, head west, passing by the archway instead of going inside the room. You'll find a path by the base of the specimen in the middle of the room going northeast. You will encounter numerous Shadow Undead and Shadow Militiamen on the first floor of the Specimen Storehouse. Keep following the path, and you'll a staircase going to the left, along with an Undead Shadow in the middle of it.
Go up the stairs, and you'll find yourself in a big room filled with bookcases. The northern side will be a dead-end, but it will have a corpse that you can loot for x1 Fire Coil.

Head northwest of it, and you will find a room that has x3 Hefty Beast Bone on a corpse lying against a table with a specimen. In this room, you will find Ansbach on the northeastern corner of the room reading a scripture. Talk to him, and exhaust all of Ansbach's dialogues. Head back out of the room, then follow the path going northwest. Turn right on the first one, and you'll find two Shadow Undead reading books, along with a hostile Shadow Undead and a Vulgar Militiaman at the base of a staircase.

After dealing with the enemies, you can keep exploring the west side of the first floor wherein you'll find a Fire Knight patrolling around a big bookcase. You can get a jump on the Fire Knight as you can easily backstab it. On the southern side of the bookcase, you'll find a corpse containing x5 Smithing Stone [8]. After looting the corpse, you can now head up the stairs.

title: SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, SECOND FLOOR
text: After getting on top of the stairs, go up the smaller set of steps on the left side. On the west side, you'll find a corpse containing x4 Black Pyrefly sitting against a table. Head down the small set of steps, then follow the path. Once the path forks out, follow the path on the right. At the end of the path, you can find x3 Smithing Stone [5] on a dead body by the railing on the right.

Once you have picked up the smithing stone, you can drop down the railing opposite of it. You'll be in a room with a corpse containing the Boltdrake Talisman +3. On the northwestern wall, you can pull a lever that opens a hidden path back to the first floor near the Site of Grace. You'll find x2 Ember of Messmer on the dead body you'll find immediately after the path opens. Backtrack your way to the stairs going up, then head left again.

Before going up the stairs going to the third floor, you can find a Fire Knight on the section underneath it. Defeat the Fire Knight, then pick up x4 Beast Horn on the dead body next to it. You can then head up the stairs going to the third floor.

title: SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, THIRD FLOOR
text: Once you go up the stairs, you'll find a Fire Knight by the southwestern side looking over the ledge. Defeat the Fire Knight first to make it easier to explore the third floor. NOTE: Take note of this location, as you'll have to backtrack to this location after a certain event. Afterwards, you are free to explore the floor as it is only filled with numerous Shadow Undead. On the south side of the third floor, you can loot x1 Blessed Bone Shard on a dead body sitting against books.

On the western side of the third floor, you'll find a room filled with Shadow Undead reading scriptures. You'll also find a Fire Knight on the southwestern side of the room. After defeating the Fire Knight, you can loot a corpse near the Fire Knight's position for x1 Beast Horn.

Head back out of the room, then go up the area with railings. Cross the bridge on the south side. Along the bridge, you can loot a dead body for x1 Furlcalling Finger Remedy. Two Shadow Militiamen will attack you as you approach the end of the bridge. Look east near the end of the bridge, and you will find an area you can jump onto from the railings. On the southern wall, you'll find x1 Dueling Shield on a dead body by the wall. Return to the path, then go southwest.

You'll find a room containing more Shadow Undead. In the first room, you'll find x2 Lump of Flesh on a dead body by the wall on the northern side. Head to the second room, and you'll find another Fire Knight patrolling around a bookcase. Backstab the Fire Knight, then finish it off. On the eastern side of the room, you can find a dead body containing x4 Beast Horn sitting against the railing.

Return to the bridge, then jump up to the feet of the hanging specimen. If you want to find more loot, you can jump down to the specimen below to get x1 Revered Spirit Ash. If you jumped down, make your way back up to the bridge, then jump up again on the feet of the hanging specimen. This time, make your way up to the head of the specimen, then jump to the fourth floor.

title: SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, FOURTH FLOOR
text: After jumping onto the fourth floor, you can loot x1 Scadutree Fragment and a Storehouse Cross Message in the middle of the room. Activate the Storehouse, Fourth Floor Site of Grace See Elden Ring Map, then you can resume your exploration of the Shadow Keep.

After activating the Site of Grace, head west to go outside. On the right side, you can find x3 Stormhawk Feather on a dead body near the ledge. Afterwards, head south, then go up the stairs. On the next set of stairs, a Fire Knight will be aggressive towards you, casting spells from afar. Before going up the stairs, you can loot a corpse on the right side of the stairs for x4 Black Pyrefly. After defeating the Fire Knight, follow the path until you find a staircase going down. Defeat the Giant Bats near the top of the stairs, then go down the stairs. On the ledge by the stairs, you can find a corpse with x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5].

After looting the dead body, head inside the room, which is another section of the fourth floor. On the northeastern side, behind the bookshelf, you can find x1 Secret Rite Scroll - an item that you need for a quest later involving Ansbach and Redmane Freyja. On the south side of the room near the entrance, you can loot a corpse for x1 Holyproof Pickled Liver. Head back out of the room, then continue following the path. Near the end of the path, you'll find a room on the left side. Before entering it, defeat the Giant Bat at the end of the path, then loot the dead body by the ledge for x3 Ember of Messmer. After looting the corpse, you can head inside the room, which will be the fifth floor of the Specimen Storehouse.

title: SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, FIFTH FLOOR
text: On the western partition of the fifth floor, you will encounter three Shadow Undead in the area. Defeat the enemies, then loot the body on the western wall for x2 Smithing Stone [6].

Afterwards, keep going in the northeast direction, clearing the path of the Shadow Undead that you encounter. You can find x2 Fire Coil on a corpse by a lectern between a bookshelf along the way. Keep following the path, eventually going north, and you will encounter another Fire Knight. Near the Fire Knight, you can find x3 Smithing Stone [7] on a corpse resting by the wall on the right. Continue following the path, and you will eventually get to the stairs leading to the sixth floor. Head up the stairs, and you'll find x1 Silver-Pickled Fowl Foot on a corpse near the top of the stairs.

title: SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, SIXTH FLOOR
text: After arriving at the sixth floor, go to the room on the south. In this room, you will encounter three Shadow Undead along with a Fire Knight with its back turned against you. After defeating the enemies, you can loot a dead body near the Fire Knight for x1 Spirit Calculus. Head back out of the room, and another Fire Knight patrolling the area will approach you. Deal with the Fire Knight, then head up the stairs to get to the seventh floor.

title: SPECIMEN STOREHOUSE, SEVENTH FLOOR
text: On the seventh floor, you can find a corpse containing x2 Sliver of Meat sitting by the rail near the stairs. Go to the room on the southwest, then activate the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]]. In this room, you can find Redmane Freyja on the other end reading a stone tablet. Talk to her, and exhaust all of her dialogues - this is part of a quest. After talking to Redmane Freyja, go back to the Storehouse, First Floor Site of Grace.

title: ANSBACH AND FREYJA
text: After arriving at the first floor, backtrack your way to Ansbach. Talk to him, then hand over the Secret Rite Scroll you found earlier to him. Keep talking to him until you get the prompt to tell him about Freyja's decision. Click on it, then Ansbach will give you the Letter for Freyja after talking to him. Go to the seventh floor, then give the Letter for Freyja to Redmane Freyja. She will then give you the Golden Lion Shield after talking to her one more time.

title: SHADOW KEEP EXPLORATION
text: Head out of the room, then head to the northeastern section of the seventh floor. Defeat the Fire Knight in this section, then head southeast to find a specimen that you can jump on to by the railing. You can find x1 Revered Spirit Ash on the back of the specimen.

Afterwards, head to the eastern room on the sixth floor. You will encounter numerous Shadow Undead in this area, along with a corpse that you can loot for x1 Shadow Realm Rune [5]. On the southern wall, you can find a lever on a platform. Pull the lever, and the mechanism in the middle will move up, also moving up the specimens hanging on it.

title: OBTAINING THE PEARLDRAKE TALISMAN
text: After the specimens have moved, make your way back to the area with the Fire Knight on the third floor (See note here). On the western side of the railing, you can find the Pearldrake Talisman +3 on a specimen that has moved up.

title: HEADING DEEPER INTO THE SHADOW KEEP
text: Go back to the Storehouse, Seventh Floor Site of Grace, then go down to the sixth floor. Go to the lever room on the east, then jump on to the beam in the middle. Make your way up the specimens, climbing onto the one with the horn. Cross it, then jump to a balcony across the horn on the west side. You will be in a room full of creatures and Shadow Undead.

Head out the room by going through the archway west of the room, then follow the path going north. Head up the stairs, and you'll find a room on the right, and a Fire Knight on the left guarding a door. Head inside the room first. In the room, you will encounter three Shadow Undead here, along with a corpse that you can loot for x3 Ember of Messmer. After clearing the room, head out then defeat the Fire Knight across the bridge. This Fire Knight is different than the rest of the Fire Knights you have found throughout exploring the Shadow Keep, as its attacks are more aggressive compared to the normal Fire Knights. Defeating this Fire Knight will give you the Winged Serpent Helm and Ash of War: Flame Spear.

Open the door across the bridge, then pick up the Scadutree Fragment directly in front of you. Head up the stairs, then activate the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace [[[Shadow of the Erdtree Map|See Elden Ring Map]]] at the top. Be prepared for a boss fight, as opening the door next to the Site of Grace will lead you to the boss of the Shadow Keep.

title: OBTAINING THE IMPENETRABLE THORNS
text: After activating the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace, you'll want to retrace your steps as to obtain the Impenetrable Thorns sorcery. Return to the bridge where you fought Kood, Captain of the Fire Knights, then cross it to the other side. Head down the first set of staircases, where you will encounter two Shadow Undead patrolling as you explore the area. You will then find a Shadow Undead overlooking the ledge. Defeat the Shadow Undead, then look down the ledge to see a platform wherein you can safely drop. After you drop to the platform, defeat the Giant Bat that you will encounter immediately after dropping. You will then see a dead body sitting against the wall nearby which you can then loot for the Impenetrable Thorns sorcery. You can then return to the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace to progress through the Shadow Keep.

title: THE DARK CHAMBER
text: IMPORTANT: Starting Messmer the Impaler's boss fight for the first time will make the summon signs for aiding/invading Hornsent disappear (through the shortcut door, at the top of the ramp from the Main Gate Plaza grace) so make sure to complete that if you desire to complete Hornsent/Needle Knight Leda's questline. If you choose to invade Hornsent and help Needle Knight Leda, you should also go back to Sir Ansbach's location near the Storehouse, First Floor grace and choose to aid/invade him as well (The Sir Ansbach fight will not be available if you aid Hornsent). Read up on their questlines on their respective pages for more information.

Near the Dark Chamber Entrance Site of Grace will be a door. Opening it will lead you to the boss, who is then revealed to be Messmer the Impaler. If you choose to aid Hornsent his summon sign will be inside the boss room. Messmer the Impaler uses a spear as a weapon, so be mindful of the range of his attacks. His spear and attacks will be imbued with fire, so having fire resistance would be a good idea for this boss fight. For a more in-depth guide on how to defeat Messmer the Impaler, you can go to this page for more information.

After defeating Messmer the Impaler, you will receive Messmer's Kindling along with the Remembrance of the Impaler. Messmer's Kindling will be used to gain access to a legacy dungeon, Enir-Ilim See Elden Ring Map. If you summoned Hornsent during the fight, rest at Messmer's Dark Chamber grace ONLY ONCE (any more than once and he will disappear) and exhaust his dialogue to continue his questline.

title: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Ancient Ruins of Rauh
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree - Path to Ancient Ruins of Rauh
Activate Viaduct Minor Tower - Site of Grace
Explore the southern section
Head to the eastern section
Fight Devonia, Crucible Knight
Eliminate Furnace Golem
Continue to the western section
Head up the ramp and fight this NPC invader
Fight Romina, Saint of the Bud

title: Crossing the Bridge from Shadow Keep
text: If you have been following this walkthrough, teleport to the West Rampart - Site of Grace in Shadow Keep. If you haven't unlocked this section, please see Shadow Keep or the Shadow Keep (Main) Tab on this page for the full walkthrough on how to reach the area.

From the Site of Grace, enter through the small archway on the right side of the bridge. It is recommended to ride Torrent here as you cross the bridge so you can move faster and loot as you travel. There will be giant bats on this bridge but you will move fast enough and they shouldn't be able to reach you. You will find lootable corpses here, the first one to the left which is a Smithing Stone [3]. Up ahead, you can loot more 3x Beast Liver, 3x Beast Blood, Smithing Stone [4], 5x Redflesh Mushroom, 8x Thin Beast Bones, and a Somber Smithing Stone [2].
At the other end of this bridge, you will encounter a Fire Knight wearing a red cloak. It wields dual daggers and can cast fire magic and will drop Salza's Hood and Rain of Fire upon defeating it.

Go inside the building behind the enemy you just defeated and take the Somber Smithing Stone [9] from the corpse on the corner. Take the spiral stairs next to it and you will reach an elevator at the top. This will take you to a new gate and then, interact with the Viaduct Minor Tower - Site of Grace here.

title: Exploring the Southern Area
text: The southern area of the Ancient Ruins of Rauh covers exploring the parts near the Site of Grace. This includes the area below you that is accessible via the elevator in the small pond.

Go through the archway and go to the right side. Stick to the wall and go ride past the thick greenery here. You will go around this building and at the back, you can pick up the Golden Horn Tender. Go back the same way you came from, return to the entrance side, and head southeast past the small pond. You can see some boar creatures hanging out here and go behind this tree. Look for the corpse lying on top of a stone slab and pick up the Spirit Calculus. Then, use the elevator to go down to the lower level.

As you go down, face the southwest direction so you are ready for the Bloodfiend waiting here. Then, follow the path behind it where a group of Bloodfiends is gathered. This can be difficult since you are outnumbered, but if you have a magic build, you can use Adula's Moonblade to effectively take out the group. After fighting them, you can pick up Somber Smithing Stone [8] from the corpse behind the group. From here, face the southwest direction and exit through the small hole. Go to the right side and go past the bloodfiend. There's a corpse near the edge and you can pick up 8x Thin Beast Bones from it.

Now look behind you; you should be facing southeast here and go towards the edge and jump down on the steps below you. Look to your right and fight the Hippopotamus. This looks just like the boss at the Main Entrance of Shadow Keep but this one has a smaller health pool. It can also pull off the same moves just like the boss version. Upon defeating it, it will drop a Scadutree Fragment. You are now done with this section. Return to the Site of Grace and continue exploring the eastern area through the felled tree.

title: Eastern Section
text: Upon exiting the archway, face the western direction and go through the collapsed tree. Follow the path ahead where you will see small creatures and make a right to to enter the building marked by these 2 standing lanterns. This area is filled with shadowy enemies and there are variations of them. Others are hunched on the ground, while there are some walking around carrying a jar. Take note that some of these enemies carry an important item. If you see them glimmering in the dark, eliminate them to take their item.

As you enter, go to your immediate right and climb up the overgrown roots. Head towards the northeast and turn left behind the pillar to pick up the Somber Smithing Stone [9] from the edge of this root. Go around this area and return to the entrance side and eliminate the Shadowpot here. This one is carrying a Revered Spirit Ash and a Silver Horn Tender. Pick it up later after you fight the Curseblade. This behaves similarly to the boss but has a lesser health pool. After defeating these enemies, face the northeast where you see this tall door.

Don't enter through the door yet, instead turn left and you will see this burning cauldron. You can pick up the Fire Spritestone on the right side of this cauldron. Then, return to the door but make sure to defeat the nearby enemies here so they can't interrupt you. Open up the door and head down the steps. You will be fighting a Giant Scorpion here, then turn left where you will fight more of these Giant Scorpions. You can pick up the Shadow Realm Rune [5] just past this lit stone.

After picking up this item, look behind you and attack this illusory wall. Go inside and pick up the Bondstone and Antiquity Scholar's Cookbook (2). Leave this area and turn right to progress. Go down the steps where a group of Shadow Undead are gathered. Pay attention to the glimmering one carrying a jar and make sure to eliminate them to get 3x Spirit Calculus from them. You can also pick up a Broken Rune in front of this square hole to the southeast. (Take note of this location because you will be coming back here later)

Go through this square hole and once you reach the other side, you will be fighting more Giant Scorpions. Watch out for the ones hiding and sleeping on the ceiling. They will attack you as you approach this loot on the corner. Go up the stones and take the Somber Smithing Stone (6) from the corpse here. Exit this area and turn right. Look for this glimmering enemy carrying a jar and defeat it. It will drop a Scadutree Fragment and Golden Horn Tender.

Then, look behind you and face the northeast direction. You will be able to see a Curseblade on the second pillar. This one will not go down unless you go near it, so you can just use range attacks to defeat it without getting damaged. After killing it, walk in front of you and pick up the 5x Throwing Dagger on the next alcove.

From the last alcove, turn right, then left. You will be facing a group of Shadow Undead and a giant scorpion here. Make sure to take them out before you continue exploring here. Loot the corpse here to get x1 Glass Shard. Continue up ahead and turn right to this room where you see a scorpion suspended in the air. You can see multiple corpses on the ground with loot on them but you need to eliminate this enemy first. Try not to the aggro of the Giant Scorpion on the other by doing ranged attacks. After doing so, pick up the x2 Sliver of Meat, x3 Scorpion Liver, and Spider Scorpion Ashes.

Head to the next area filled with white flowers and defeat the Giant Scorpions here. You can also pick up 2x Dewgem from the corpse here. Then, return to the other side of the square hole that you entered earlier. Trace your steps and return to the area where the Shadow Undead are gathered. Open the door here facing southwest, then, take the 5x Rauh Burrow from the corpse to your right.

Follow this path until you reach this Spiritspring with surrounding nails. You can jump down here while riding Torrent and you will not be damaged. Face the southeast direction and go to the very end of this path. Pick up the Shadow Realm Rune (6) behind the Spiritspring. Don't go up the spiritspring and head back towards the area where you came from.

Turn right behind the 3rd pillar, and then go up the thick roots to pick up the Fine Crucible Feather Talisman. Then, head southwest and exit through the small archway at the end. Turn left and you will see an item on the top of the first archway to your left. Behind it, you can use the overgrown branch to climb this arch and then pickup the Shadow Realm Rune (7) from the corpse. Continue riding southeast and you will reach the outdoor area.

When this enemy comes into view, don't try to take its aggro right away. You want to be able to reach the nearby Site of Grace here by walking only on the right side. Stick to the edge on your right and you will see Miquella's Cross here near the edge. The Rauh Ancient Ruins, East - Site of Grace is on your right and you can pick up an Ancient Ruins Cross Message and Scadutree Fragment on the ground near the cross.

From the Site of Grace, face northeast and go towards the pillar here. Walk over the edge to find an item near the waterfall. Pick up the Ash of War: Dryleaf Whirlwind here. Then, return to the enemy that you saw earlier. This Lesser Crucible Knight will drop Devonia's Hammer and Crucible Hammer-Helm upon defeating it.

After defeating this enemy, cross the bridge facing southwest. There's a Furnace Golem at the other end of this bridge and it will start attacking you as you jump down. There are also Shadow Undead along the way and you can pick up 4x Dewgem and 2x Flight Pinion. Then, jump down to the right side here. Ride up ahead but make sure to sprint so you can safely reach the covered area here. Then, go past the Furnace Golem, and don't fight it for now. The Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace is in the area behind it so you want to get the checkpoint first.

title: The Western Section Part 1
text: From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace, go down the ramp and fight the Furnace Golem. It will drop the Crimson-Sapping Cracked Tear and a Furnace Visage upon defeating it.

After fighting the Furnace Golem, teleport to the Site that you had just activated. Face the southwest direction and go toward the double archway. There are different Shadow Undead here, like shadow mage and shadow hound. Eliminate them as you go and go up the stairs to the right. You can pick up a 6x Kukri on the steps and Redflesh Mushroom from the enemies.

Go up the steps, then, go to the right side and eliminate the glimmering Shadowpot here. It will drop x3 Spirit Calculus and a Rauh Burrow. Then, defeat the 2 Shadow Mages here. At the center of this map, there's a Curseblade. This one uses death spells and is just as dangerous as the boss version. On the northwest side, there's an altar where Shadow Undead are worshipping. Go towards it and pick up the Scadutree Fragment.

Then, explore towards south and then turn right. Make sure to pick up the Rauh Burrow and 2x Spiritgrave Stone along the way. Then, use the elevator at the end of this path that will take you to the stone pillar section. Go to the left then jump down on the stone pillar below you. Try to land on the widest portion here and follow the steps 1 to 3. When you get to the 3rd jump, look to the pillar behind you and pick up the Four-Toed Fowl Foot from the corpse.

Keep following the steps here and then face southeast and jump towards the building on the far end to the left. Eliminate the 2 enemies holding a candlestick standing in front of the steps here. Face the building and go towards the square hole to the left, then turn left again to reach the chest. You can get the Talisman of All Crucibles inside.

title: The Grand Stairway Section
text: While facing the chest, exit through the square hole to your right. Use the elevator to go up, and you can already see the Ancient Ruins, Grand Stairway - Site of Grace from the top. Walk towards it and activate it.

Face the northwest direction, jump down the stairs, and then turn right to get loot. Stick to the wall to your right and then go to the very edge here to pick up a Spirit Calculus from a corpse. Then, return to the grand stairway where you see the archer version of the Golem Warrior. You can go up the ramp behind it and take it out. This enemy is weak to heavy attacks so make sure to take full advantage of its weakness.

Go down the broken bridge here and cross towards the northeast. Near the end of this bridge, you will find a corpse in the middle and you can take a Shadow Realm Rune (7) from it. If you look down to the right, there's a Divine Beast Dancing Lion field boss here - please read ahead before jumping down! It's up to you if you want to fight it head-on but if you ended up jumping down to its level, you can run away from it by jumping down yet again on the northeastern platform. This disables the fight and the boss will not chase you. Oddly enough, this field boss can also be sniped from the bridge you're on from above. Fair warning, it will spawn basilisks onto the bridge but this is the biggest threat you'll encounter and it is easily defeated using this method. After defeat it drops the Divine Beast Tornado Incantation.

After the Dancing Lion fight head northeast and jump down off the platform. There's an elite enemy in the middle of the pool. This one wields dual curved swords and has a chance to drop pieces of the Divine Bird Set upon defeating it. Go up the ramp on the left side to pick up 2x Beast Bones. Then, go to the area behind the boss to pick up Verdigris Discus. Continue exploring the southern area here to pick up a Redflesh Mushroom from a corpse next to a pillar. This is your last stop in the Grand Stairway section and you will now return to the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace.

title: The Western Section Part 2
text: This covers the rest of the exploration of the western section where you will be invaded by an NPC.

From the Rauh Ancient Ruins, West - Site of Grace, face the southwest section and climb up the stairs to the left. This is the same area that you explore earlier but instead of going to the left section, you will head northwest towards the outdoor area. Head straight into the gazebo in front of you and you can pick up the Revered Spirit Ash on this altar. Watch out for the enemy nearby but since you are riding Torrent, you can just outrun them.

Continue exploring the path behind this gazebo and make sure to pick up this Rauh Burrow on the wall. Take note of the location on your left because you will be returning here later. For now, continue ahead and jump down on the platform behind this stone.

Go to the bottom of the steps and head northeast. You will find hounds inflicted with Scarlet rot here and you can pick up Golden Horn Tender from this corpse in the middle. There's a Bloodfiend here in the middle of this section but it's up to you if you want to fight it. You can get 5x Sacred Bloody Flesh if you want to fight it. Continue traveling north where you will encounter another Bloodfiend, then turn left where more enemies are waiting. Take out the hounds and bloodfiends here for a chance to get Beast Blood and a piece of the bloodfiend's gear, like Bloodfiend's Fork.

On the upper area, while facing northwest, you will see this glimmering Shadowpot. To go there, you need to head to jump down on the area below it. Summon Torrent and try to land on the highest part here to minimize your fall damage. The elevator is right here when you go down, but before that, make sure to head to the area on the northeast. This area is protected by giant flies, so you need to eliminate them first.

Take the Somber Smithing Stone (1) from the corpse lying on the stone. After doing so, head east where you see the Pink Flowerbloom. Go towards it and then pick up the Aspects of the Crucible: Bloom. Now, return to where you jumped down and take the elevator to go up. On the top level, you will reach a Shadowpot which drops a Revered Spirit Ash. You can then eliminate the nearby enemies to get a Redflesh Mushroom and Silver Horn Tender.

This is your last stop in this area and you will now be returning to the area that we mentioned that you will be coming back to. Jump down on the same ledge that you are facing as you approached the loot, then look behind this pillar and you will see a corpse here. Take the 3x Knot Resin from it then go up the stairs.

Turn right where you will be facing scarlet rot-inflicted enemies. There's a scarlet version of Lesser Kindred of Rot (Pests) here, be careful of them because they can deal a high amount of damage when you get struck by them.

Go to the northwest arch and pick up the Dappled White Cured Meat. To your right, there are more pest enemies here. There's a large group of them in the next section and try to cheese them as much as you can. If you have any ranged or magic attacks, make use of them to eliminate them before they get near you. You can obtain these items from the ground here: x3 Immunizing Cured Meat, x4 Fly Mold, and x8 Smithing Stone (2). After fighting them, exit through the archway on the left side. Look on the stack of stones to your right and you will see a corpse here. You can pick up the Greater Potentate's Cookbook (9) from it.

Face the tower to the northeast and walk straight towards it. This is the Unseen Bridge that connects the main building to this tower. Cross to the other side and interact with the altar: if you have the Stone-Sheathed Sword, you can use it on this altar and it will turn into the Sword of Light.

Go back to the main building the same way you got here and then continue exploring by going to the left past the room. Then, turn right to use the elevator that will take you to the upper level. There are more pest enemies here at the top and you will see the stairs in the middle. Just take note of these areas for now because you will be returning here later.

First, turn your attention to the nearest enemy standing next to the archway then go out to the area outside. Go past the gazebo and look at the corpse in the middle of the water. Go towards it and then pick up the Divine Bird Feathers.

The elite enemy here will be aggro-ed upon picking up the item. Take your time as you deal with it and use the pillars of the gazebo to defend yourself against some of its attacks. After fighting it, go up the ramp and go to the edge. You will see the clusters of stones that unlock a Spiritspring after destroying it.

Jump towards the Spiritspring, then use it again to reach the area on the other side. Go to the right side and walk to the area behind the thick pillar and go around it to pick up x2 Beast Horn from the corpse. Then, go up the stairs that you saw earlier and open the chest at the top to get Mottled Necklace +2. Use the Spiritspring again to return to the other side. Head back inside where you used the elevator and then turn left.

Fight the pests that you will come across here and then turn right at the end. You can pick up the Pest-Thread Spears next to the wall on your right side. Go around this area and get ready for a fight before you head up the stairs. As you approach the top section, Hornsent will invade you. This is potentially a long walk back if you didn't activate the Spiritspring beforehand, but if you have been following this walkthrough, you will have a faster way of reaching this area in case you die.
The Spiritspring is located just northwest of the Site of Grace, in the pool area. Defeating Hornsent here will reward you with the following items:
Falx
Caterpillar Mask
Braided Cord Robe
Braided Arm Wraps
Soiled Loincloth

title: Fight Romina in the Church of the Bud
text: Romina, Saint of the Bud, is a mid-sized boss with a body resembling a centipede, a scorpion, the wings of a butterfly, and a human. She wields a spear, centipede fangs, and a scorpion stinger, making her a unique foe. To defeat Romina, you'll need a balanced approach, mixing both offense and defense. When facing her as a melee character, focus not only on her central human body but also observe her centipede fangs and scorpion stinger, which act as her arms.

Defeating Romina Saint of the Bud will reward you 280,000 Runes and Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud. This fight will also let you access the Sealing Tree behind the arena. You will need Messmer's Kindling to burn the Sealing Tree to gain access to the final legacy dungeon. After the short cutscene, the real Enir-Ilim will be revealed and you will be transported to the base of Enir-Ilim.
See the next tab for the Enir-Ilim Walkthrough. Click here to return to the tab selection.

title: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Walkthrough - Enir-Ilim
text: Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree Enir-Ilim - A Legacy Dungeon
Fight Needle Knight Leda and her allies.
Pick up all rewards.
Defeat the final boss.

All NPC Encounters and Fight: When youreach Needle Knight Leda's location in Enir-Ilim, you will be fighting some of Miquella's followers here. Depending on the choices that you have made so far, those who will be siding with Leda will vary. See the progression below:
Needle Knight Leda attacks you no matter what your choices have been.

Redmane Freyja: She will attack you if you gave her the Letter for Freyja from Sir Ansbach in Shadow Keep. Defeating her here will drop her items. Otherwise, she will stay in the Storehouse and will disappear to leave behind Golden Lion Shield in Shadow Keep.
Hornsent: Hornsent will go after you if you didn't summon him during the fight against Messmer. You will also encounter him on the way to Enir-Ilim before fighting this boss.
Moore: The merchant will attack you in this arena if you choose the dialogue to "Put it behind you" and then, you will be able to get his items. See his page for more info.
Dryleaf Dane: Just like Leda, he will attack you, no matter what your choices have been.
Thiollier: If you progress his quest and pass the message of St. Trina, he can be summoned as a cooperator.
Final Boss Fight: If you helped Ansbach and Thiollier with their quests, both of them can be summoned as cooperators.
Enir-Ilim
150 - Above
Promised Consort Radahn

Enir-Ilim is a Legacy Dungeon in Elden Ring. Enir-Ilim is a dungeon exclusive to the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. You can gain access to an area containing a sealing tree by defeating Romina, Saint of the Bud in the Church of the Bud. You can then burn the sealing tree by using Messmer's Kindling, which you can obtain by defeating Messmer the Impaler. Enir-Ilim will reveal its true form after burning the sealing tree, teleporting you inside of it.

title: How to Get the Euporia Weapon in Elden Ring
text: Keep following it, and you will acquire x10 Lordsworn's Bolt from a dead body at the end of it. After looting the body, follow the ledge to the other direction going down, and you'll be at a broken section of the ledge. Drop down it, and you will land near a hostile Shadow Undead. Kill it, then pick up x1 Somber Smithing Stone [5] nearby. Go down the stairs, and you'll find x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver from a dead body.

title: Belurat Tower Settlement Section
text: To progress further, sprint jump down the window south of the dead body containing x1 Fireproof Pickled Liver.
After obtaining the Euporia twinblade, head back to the Spiral Rise Site of Grace to continue going up Enir-Ilim.

title: Promised Consort Radahn
text: After you have defeated Radahn, you will receive the Remembrance of a God and a Lord. The Gate of Divinity Site of Grace [See Elden Ring Map] will also be unlocked. If you look around the area, southeast of the Site of Grace, you can pick up the equipment of those who assisted you in the fight. You can pick up Thiollier's Set along with his weapon, Thiollier's Hidden Needle, from his body. You can also pick up Ansbach's Set, his weapon Obsidian Lamina, and the incantation Furious Blade of Ansbach.
In the middle of the arena, you can obtain the emote Let Us Go Together. You can play a memory, triggering a cutscene. After the cutscene, you will obtain the Circlet of Light.

links.text: Remembrance of a God and a Lord

title: First Rise
text: You will then face a Cursed Erdtree Shaman roaming in the bigger courtyard, along with priests scattered around the corners of the courtyard. Defeat all the hostiles in the area, then head up the stairs. You will encounter another priest which dies in two or three hits. Keep following the path, and you'll encounter a Horned Warrior approaching the area. Defeat the Horned Warrior, then look at the platform across the one you are on. Go there by traversing through the tree branches. You can obtain x3 Furlcalling Finger Remedy right where you dropped. As you get on the platform, you'll encounter a Cursed Erdtree Priest there. After dealing with the priest, you can then pick up the Spira incantation. You can head back dropping down, then going through the path you went from originally.

Once you're back from where you dropped to the branches, follow the path going up. You can pick up a Dragonbolt Grease by the stairs, but there will be a flurry of magic attacks. The one casting the spell will be on top of the stairs, so you can sprint towards the enemy, a Cursed Erdtree Mage, to stop the attack. After that, you can deal with the mage on the rooftop near the next staircase going up by using ranged attacks. If you have no ranged attack options, you can just sprint to the top of the stairs, then defeat the priest on top of it. Along the way, you can loot dead bodies for x10 Fire Arrow and x10 Golden Bolt. Open the door to gain access to the Spiral Rise Site of Grace.
Note: Right before going up the stairs to the Site of Grace, you can find a staircase going down which will eventually lead you to a room containing the twinblade Euporia.

title: Spiral Rise
text: You will arrive in a rooftop section with a Horned Warrior that uses frost spells. After defeating the Horned Warrior, climb up the rooftop until you find an opening to the structure containing the First Rise Site of Grace. Keep heading up the stairs until you get to the top of the structure. You'll end up in an area with a lift, and Cursed Erdtree Priests on the corners of the room. After clearing the area, you can head outside through the archway. In this area, you will encounter a Horned Warrior using wind spells. After dealing with the Horned Warrior, go up the stairs to open the door leading to the Cleansing Chamber Anteroom, then activate the area's Site of Grace. You can pick up a Scadutree Fragment southeast of the Site of Grace.
